mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.product_id, p.name AS product_name, d.scheduled_at, d.end_at, d.total_quantity, d.status, d.created_at FROM drops d JOIN products p ON d.product_id = p.id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.scheduled_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.product_id, p.name AS product_name, d.scheduled_at, d.end_at, d.total_quantity, d.status, d.created_at FROM drops d JOIN products p ON d.product_id = p.id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id, d.product_id, p.name AS product_name, d.scheduled_at, d.end_at, d.total_quantity, d.status, d.created_at FROM drops d JOIN products p ON d.product_id = p.id WHERE d.status = #{status} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.scheduled_at ASC
